actual: The merged P2-4 CLI requires a fully hashed hmm_risk_p2_4_holdout_request_v1 before parent preflight, but no tracked builder or command can generate it from the frozen source authority. The only current workaround is an out-of-band full holdout source read followed by hand-built JSON, which bypasses D1 output identity closure, logical holdout access accounting, collision safety, and typed failure receipts. Add the minimal controlled request-preparation path using the existing canonical source loader/serializer, persist exact repo-external outputs and failure state, preserve zero fit/selection/DB/runtime semantics, and prove the formal parent consumes the generated request without changing D1-D6.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
